description: P0.3: dragon_first_double's extra attack itself finishes off a target that survived the main hit (main hit deals 27, leaving 1 HP; the extra full-power hit deals 24 and is the actual killing blow) -- the natural post-chain faint dispatch (onKO/onFaint/send-out) must fire off the EXTRA hit's HP change. Gen1 so ability_config/traits_config are both null -- isolates extra-attack faint timing from hook re-entry (see dragon_first_double_merged.json for the hook-bearing case).
